title: Home · Energy & water
description: Smart-plug power, what it costs at the Nord Pool spot price, and water use.

panels.title: Spot price now

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, avg(price) AS "Value"
FROM nordpool_price WHERE time > now() - interval '2 hours' AND time <= now()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) p ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Nord Pool hourly spot price for Finland (excl. transfer and margin).

panels.title: Metered plugs now

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(w) AS "Value" FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (name) raw_19 / 10.0 AS w FROM mqtt_consumer
  WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND time > now() - interval '10 minutes'
  ORDER BY name, time DESC) l

panels.description: Sum of the Tuya smart plugs only, not the whole house.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum("Value") / 1000 AS "Value" FROM (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, name AS device, avg(raw_19) / 10.0 AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND time >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1) h

SELECT sum("Value") AS "Value" FROM (
WITH energy AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, name AS device, avg(raw_19) / 10.0 AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND time >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1),
price AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, avg(price) AS "Value"
FROM nordpool_price WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1)
SELECT time, device, energy."Value" / 1000 * price."Value" / 100 AS "Value"
FROM energy JOIN price USING (time) ORDER BY 1) q

SELECT sum("Value") AS "Value" FROM (
WITH energy AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, name AS device, avg(raw_19) / 10.0 AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND time >= date_trunc('month', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '31 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1),
price AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, avg(price) AS "Value"
FROM nordpool_price WHERE time >= date_trunc('month', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '31 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1)
SELECT time, device, energy."Value" / 1000 * price."Value" / 100 AS "Value"
FROM energy JOIN price USING (time) ORDER BY 1) q

SELECT sum("Value") AS "Value" FROM (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, sum(rate) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id IS NULL AND device_id IS NULL AND name = 'watermeter' AND time >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '1 day'
  AND rate > -20 AND rate < 20
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) w

panels.title: Spot price today and tomorrow

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, avg(price) AS "Value"
FROM nordpool_price WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '1 day' AND time < date_trunc('day', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') + interval '2 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Tomorrow's prices appear after Nord Pool publishes them, around 14:00.

panels.title: Price by hour of day (last 30 days)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time,
       to_char(time_bucket('1 hour', time) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki', 'HH24') AS hour, avg(price) AS "Value"
FROM nordpool_price WHERE time > now() - interval '30 days' AND time <= now()
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Each row is an hour of the day, each column a day; darker is more expensive.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), name AS device, avg(raw_19) / 10.0 AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost by plug this month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(time) AS time, device, sum("Value") AS "Value" FROM (
WITH energy AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, name AS device, avg(raw_19) / 10.0 AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND time >= date_trunc('month', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '31 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1),
price AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, avg(price) AS "Value"
FROM nordpool_price WHERE time >= date_trunc('month', now(), 'Europe/Helsinki') AND time > now() - interval '31 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1)
SELECT time, device, energy."Value" / 1000 * price."Value" / 100 AS "Value"
FROM energy JOIN price USING (time) ORDER BY 1) c GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Spot-price cost of each plug's metered energy since the 1st.

targets.rawSql:

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, name AS device, avg(raw_19) / 10.0 AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1) h
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, device, sum("Value") AS "Value"
FROM (
WITH energy AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, name AS device, avg(raw_19) / 10.0 AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1),
price AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, avg(price) AS "Value"

GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1)
SELECT time, device, energy."Value" / 1000 * price."Value" / 100 AS "Value"

panels.title: Compressor duty cycle

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, name AS device,
       avg(CASE WHEN raw_19 > 200 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id = 'tuya' AND raw_19 IS NOT NULL AND name IN ('Fridge', 'Freezer') AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Share of each day the compressor drew over 20 W. A steady climb means a door seal or condenser problem; a one-day spike means a door was left open.

panels.title: Fridge & freezer temperature

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), place, avg(tempc) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer JOIN (VALUES ('C76A0306280B', 'Fridge'), ('D43535302778', 'Freezer')) AS n (device_id, place) USING (device_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND device_id IN ('C76A0306280B', 'D43535302778') AND tempc IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Fridge should sit at 2–6 °C, the freezer at −16 °C or colder.

panels.title: Last 12 months

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum("Value") AS "Value" FROM (
SELECT time, kwh AS "Value" FROM electricity WHERE time > now() - interval '365 days' ORDER BY 1) q

panels.description: From Fingrid Datahub exports, imported with scripts/datahub-import.py. Datahub data arrives 1–2 days late and only when imported.

panels.title: Expected from weather

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum("Value") AS "Value" FROM (
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, 'Expected from weather' AS series,
       19.9 + 1.86 * greatest(10.5 - value, 0) AS "Value"
FROM fmi_daily WHERE param = 'tday' AND time > now() - interval '365 days' ORDER BY 1) q

panels.description: What the 2021–2024 house would have used in the same weather: 19.9 kWh/day plus 1.86 kWh for each degree the daily mean is below 10.5 °C.

panels.title: Electricity per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, 'Used' AS series, sum(kwh) AS "Value"
FROM electricity WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, 'Expected from weather' AS series,
       19.9 + 1.86 * greatest(10.5 - value, 0) AS "Value"
FROM fmi_daily WHERE param = 'tday' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Bars: the house's metered use. Line: what the weather model expects.

panels.title: Use vs weather-expected (30-day)

targets.rawSql:
WITH used AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, 'Used' AS series, sum(kwh) AS "Value"
FROM electricity WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1),
exp AS (
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, 'Expected from weather' AS series,
       19.9 + 1.86 * greatest(10.5 - value, 0) AS "Value"
FROM fmi_daily WHERE param = 'tday' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1),
days AS (SELECT time FROM used UNION SELECT time FROM exp),
win AS (
  SELECT d.time + interval '1 day' AS time,
         avg(used."Value") OVER w AS u, avg(exp."Value") OVER w AS e
  FROM days d LEFT JOIN used USING (time) LEFT JOIN exp USING (time)
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.time RANGE BETWEEN interval '29 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
SELECT time, u / e AS "Value" FROM win WHERE u IS NOT NULL AND e IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Above 100 % means more electricity than the 2021–2024 house used in the same weather: a new always-on load, the electric heater, or a less efficient heat pump.

panels.title: Night base load

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 week', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY kwh) AS "Value"
FROM electricity
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND extract(hour FROM time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki') BETWEEN 2 AND 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Median hourly use between 02 and 05, per week. In summer this is the always-on load (fridge, freezer, network, homelab, ventilation).

panels.title: CO₂ now

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingrid.series) time, n.label AS series, value AS "Value"
  FROM fingrid JOIN (VALUES ('co2_consumption', 'Consumed')) AS n (code, label) ON fingrid.series = n.code
  WHERE time > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND fingrid.series IN ('co2_consumption')
  ORDER BY fingrid.series, time DESC) l ORDER BY time

panels.description: Grams of CO₂ per kWh of electricity consumed in Finland, including imports (Fingrid, 3 min).

panels.title: Grid state

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingrid.series) time, n.label AS series, value AS "Value"
  FROM fingrid JOIN (VALUES ('system_state', 'System'), ('shortage_status', 'Shortage')) AS n (code, label) ON fingrid.series = n.code
  WHERE time > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND fingrid.series IN ('system_state', 'shortage_status')
  ORDER BY fingrid.series, time DESC) l ORDER BY time

panels.description: Fingrid's power system state and electricity shortage status.

panels.title: Your CO₂, last 12 months

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum("Value") AS "Value" FROM (
WITH co2 AS (
  SELECT hour, avg(c) AS c FROM (
    SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS hour, value AS c
    FROM fingrid_hourly WHERE series = 'co2_consumption' AND time > now() - interval '365 days'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time), avg(value)
    FROM fingrid WHERE series = 'co2_consumption' AND time > now() - interval '365 days' GROUP BY 1) u
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT e.time, e.kwh * co2.c / 1000 AS "Value"
FROM electricity e JOIN co2 ON co2.hour = e.time
WHERE e.time > now() - interval '365 days' ORDER BY 1) q

panels.description: Metered use each hour times that hour's CO₂ intensity of consumption.

panels.title: Import / export

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingrid.series) time, n.label AS series, value AS "Value"
  FROM fingrid JOIN (VALUES ('net_import', 'Net import')) AS n (code, label) ON fingrid.series = n.code
  WHERE time > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND fingrid.series IN ('net_import')
  ORDER BY fingrid.series, time DESC) l ORDER BY time

panels.description: Positive: Finland imports electricity; negative: exports.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), n.label AS series, avg(value) AS "Value"
FROM fingrid JOIN (VALUES ('nuclear', 'Nuclear'), ('hydro', 'Hydro'), ('wind', 'Wind')) AS n (code, label) ON fingrid.series = n.code
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND fingrid.series IN ('nuclear', 'hydro', 'wind')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), 'Other' AS series,
         avg(value) FILTER (WHERE series = 'production') - avg(value) FILTER (WHERE series = 'nuclear')
         - avg(value) FILTER (WHERE series = 'hydro') - avg(value) FILTER (WHERE series = 'wind') AS "Value"
  FROM fingrid
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND series IN ('production', 'nuclear', 'hydro', 'wind')
  GROUP BY 1) o
WHERE "Value" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), n.label AS series, avg(value) AS "Value"
FROM fingrid JOIN (VALUES ('co2_consumption', 'Consumed'), ('co2_production', 'Produced')) AS n (code, label) ON fingrid.series = n.code
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND fingrid.series IN ('co2_consumption', 'co2_production')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Your electricity CO₂ per month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 month', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, sum("Value") AS "Value"
FROM (
WITH co2 AS (
  SELECT hour, avg(c) AS c FROM (
    SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS hour, value AS c
    FROM fingrid_hourly WHERE series = 'co2_consumption' AND $__timeFilter(time)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time), avg(value)
    FROM fingrid WHERE series = 'co2_consumption' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) u
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT e.time, e.kwh * co2.c / 1000 AS "Value"
FROM electricity e JOIN co2 ON co2.hour = e.time
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time) ORDER BY 1) c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The Finnish grid got much cleaner after Olkiluoto 3 and the wind build-out: similar use, a third of the emissions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, sum(rate) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id IS NULL AND device_id IS NULL AND name = 'watermeter' AND $__timeFilter(time)
  AND rate > -20 AND rate < 20
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, sum(rate) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id IS NULL AND device_id IS NULL AND name = 'watermeter' AND $__timeFilter(time)
  AND rate > -20 AND rate < 20
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Night-time water (02–05)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, sum(rate) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id IS NULL AND device_id IS NULL AND name = 'watermeter' AND $__timeFilter(time)
  AND rate > -20 AND rate < 20 AND extract(hour FROM time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki') BETWEEN 2 AND 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Water used between 02:00 and 05:00. A few litres every night points at a running toilet or a dripping tap.
